record.original_question: Let Δ ⊂ TM be a smooth vector distribution on a manifold M. Suppose Δ is singular transitive, meaning that any two points of M can be joined by a concatenation of singular curves of Δ. Does this singular transitivity force the full symmetry group of Δ—the diffeomorphisms Φ with Φ_*Δ = Δ—to be a finite-dimensional Lie group?

evidence.quote: A natural open question is as follows: Is it true that singular transitivity of the distribution implies that its symmetry group is a finite dimensional Lie group?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth manifold and let $\Delta \subset TM$ be a smooth vector distribution on $M$ (a smooth subbundle, or more generally a smooth submodule of the tangent sheaf). A smooth curve $\gamma:[0,1]\to M$ is called horizontal for $\Delta$ if $\dot\gamma(t)\in\Delta_{\gamma(t)}$ for almost every $t$. Among horizontal curves one distinguishes the so-called singular (or abnormal) curves: these are the critical points of the endpoint map on the space of horizontal curves with fixed initial point (equivalently, horizontal curves admitting a nontrivial abnormal Pontryagin extremal lift in $T^*M$).

Say that $\Delta$ is singular transitive on $M$ if any two points of $M$ can be joined by a finite concatenation of singular curves of $\Delta$. Define the symmetry group of $\Delta$ to be
$$\mathrm{Sym}(\Delta) := \{\Phi \in \mathrm{Diff}(M) : \Phi_*\Delta = \Delta\}.$$

Question: Does singular transitivity of $\Delta$ imply that $\mathrm{Sym}(\Delta)$ is a finite-dimensional Lie group?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return any source explicitly resolving the question of whether singular transitivity of a smooth distribution forces its symmetry pseudogroup to be a finite-dimensional Lie group. No paper claiming a proof or counterexample was located, so the status remains unverified.

status_evidence.title: Algebraic integrability and minimality of Lie equations for transitive, finite dimensional, non-commutative pseudogroups
status_evidence.snippet: Algebraic characterization of transitive, finite-dimensional algebraic Lie pseudogroups; does not address singular transitivity of distributions.
status_evidence.claim: Related work on transitive finite-dimensional Lie pseudogroups exists, but no resolution of the singular-transitivity question was found.
